newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-PacMags says publishing earnings rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-PacMags says publishing earnings rise.

text.p: Pacific Magazines and Printing Ltd (PMP) said on Tuesday its publishing earnings were continuing to grow in the 1996/97 (July-June).

"Publishing earnings continue to grow in the current year," PMP chairman Ken Cowley told the annual meeting, noting that sluggish business conditions in Australia in the second half had impacted on 1995/96 profits.
He said the takeover of CD maker Shomega Ltd earlier this year was expected to eventually stimulate sales volumes.
The meeting is considering changing the company's name to PMP Communications ltd.
